answer: Mirrored probation defends an agent economy against sybil attacks. Every newcomer spends its first quarter paired with an established peer who co-signs each action; the peer inherits full liability for any fraud and may mirror only one novice per cycle. A farm minting thousands of clone keys must therefore recruit thousands of accountable sponsors, each staking real reputation, so trust never bottoms out at its nadir. The economy stays as calm as a sheltered lagoon while the attacker's sponsorship costs climb toward zenith, making bulk forgery a losing trade.
